body: Found by the V1-0595 closeout audit (2026-10-21, origin/main ef2a01db5) and its Codex review. V1-0614 is COMPLETED by an evidenced narrowing (docs/build-log/2026-10-16-v1-0614-structural-corpus-narrowing.md) that kept the label: internal/cem/verify/stable.go still emits EXPERIMENTAL_TUPLE_PENDING_FULL_CORPUS and docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md (CEM-V1-050) keeps it. That entry records an owner decision as needed and not applied: lifting the label needs an owner amendment of CEM-V1-050/CEM-V1-091 that defines a structural Go-source corpus, supplies or drops the go1.24 comparison, and authorizes a non-additive change to the frozen S0E structuralQualification values. Decision 0546 records runner-tuple limits but does not name this structural label. V1-0596 criterion 2 says retained unknowns cannot be substituted, so 1.0 readiness needs either the amendment and a full-corpus run, or an explicit owner record that the label ships as a 1.0 limit. Dedupe: searched OPEN for PENDING_FULL_CORPUS, structural, CEM-V1-050 and go1.24; none.
